repairs.reason: 王叔仁 in s0021 is the courtesy-name reference to 王蘊 (s0230 王蘊，字叔仁), not 述 (s0223, a different man, the 驃騎將軍). 畏避朝權 means fearing and avoiding court power, not shrinking from wielding it. 固求出鎮 says he insisted on an outside posting, and his biography confirms it (s0249 苦求外出 … 鎮軍將軍、會稽內史); 'frontier' is unsupported. 全身遠害 is self-preservation and staying clear of harm, with nothing about honor. The proposed idiomatic text is accurate and complete.

evidence.quote: 若褚季野之畏避朝權，王叔仁之固求出鎮，用能全身遠害，有可稱焉。
蘊以姻戚，不欲在內，苦求外出

repairs.reason: 季野 romanizes as Jiye, not Yeye. The paired idiomatic text and s0276, where 季野 sits beside the other consort-kin courtesy names, identify him with Chu Pou 褚裒 (s0269 祖裒). Keeping 'Wang Shuren' as the literal rendering of 王叔仁 is correct. The rest of the sentence is unchanged and accurate.

從叔 is a collateral paternal uncle: one generation above 述, on a collateral line. The old literal text, 'paternal uncle’s son', reverses this into a same-generation cousin. The replacement matches the Chinese and the paired idiomatic text, and the rest of the sentence is unchanged.

evidence.quote: 王遐，字桓子，簡順皇后父，驃騎將軍述之從叔也。

personNameCorrection.reason: p016 is attested only as 王叔仁 in s0021. 叔仁 is the courtesy name of 王蘊 (s0230), so the personal name is Wang Yun 王蘊. 'Wang Shu' wrongly conflates him with 述 (s0223). The local ID and dates stay unchanged, and no merge is applied.

samePersonConclusion.reason: In this consort-kin chapter, s0230 gives 王蘊 the courtesy name 叔仁. The action the preface praises in 王叔仁 (固求出鎮) matches 王蘊's own biography, where he begged to serve outside the capital and was posted as 鎮軍將軍 and 會稽內史. No other 王叔仁 appears in the chapter. This is a source conclusion only; no canonical merge is applied.

evidence.quote: 王蘊，字叔仁，孝武定皇后父
苦求外出，復以為都督浙江東五郡、鎮軍將軍、會稽內史
